title: Call For Paper
description: Conference seeks papers in all aspects of Soft Computing Techniques in Renewable Energy Systems and Smart Grid Technologies. Researchers, academicians, industry experts, and practitioners are invited to submit original research contributions related to intelligent energy systems and sustainable computing solutions.

tracks.title: Research Tracks
tracks.description: The conference invites submissions in all areas related to Soft Computing Applications in Smart Grid and Renewable Energy, including but not limited to the following tracks:

list.title: Track 1: Power Systems and Smart Grids
list.description:
• Power generation, transmission, and distribution
• Power system operation and control
• Smart grid technologies and applications
• Renewable energy integration and grid integration challenges
• Grid resilience and reliability enhancement
• Energy storage systems and management
• Demand-side management and demand response strategies
• Smart Grid Planning and Operation

list.title: Track 2: AI & ML Application and Cyber Security
list.description:
• AI-Based Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS)
• Phishing and Spam Detection Using Machine Learning
• Malware Classification with Deep Learning
• Network Anomaly Detection Using AI
• Adversarial Attacks and Defenses in Machine Learning

list.title: Track 3: Application of Optimization Techniques
list.description:
• Power System Optimization
• Vehicle Routing and Logistics Optimization
• Hyperparameter Optimization in Machine Learning
• Smart Grid Energy Management Optimization
• Production and Inventory Scheduling Optimization
• Resource Allocation in Cloud Computing Using Optimization Algorithms

list.title: Track 4: Power Electronics and Intelligent Control Systems
list.description:
• Intelligent Control of Power Converters
• Advanced Inverter Technologies
• Control Strategies for Renewable Energy Systems
• FACTS Devices and Smart Grid Applications
• Adaptive and Robust Control Techniques
• Embedded Systems for Smart Energy Applications
• Automation in Power Systems
• Electric Vehicle and Charging Station

list.title: Track 5: Emerging Technologies and Future Trends
list.description:
• Internet of Things (IoT) and Communication Techniques
• Quantum Computing Applications in Energy Systems
• Green Hydrogen Technologies
• AI-Driven Carbon Neutrality Solutions
• Internet of Energy (IoE)
• Smart Energy Markets and Trading
• Digital Transformation in Power Systems
• Future Challenges in Renewable Energy and Smart Grids

footer.title: Ready to Submit?
footer.description: Join researchers and innovators working towards sustainable energy systems, smart grids, and intelligent renewable energy technologies.
